gaps.title: Reusable CLI Command Dispatcher & Argument Validator
gaps.observedFailure: During Phase F construction, Model had to write custom procedural argument parsing in bin/cli.mjs because Brain lacked a standard, reusable CLI dispatch pattern.
gaps.rootCause: Existing Engineering Patterns define exit codes (0, 1, 2) but omit a modular, zero-dependency dispatcher library for command routing, help text formatting, and typed flag parsing.
gaps.proposedImprovement: Implement CliCommandDispatcher: a pure Node.js modular class managing subcommand registration, positional argument clamping, flag extraction (--flag, --opt <val>), automated manual formatting, and standardized error handling.

gaps.title: Post-Extraction Schema Invariant Validator
gaps.observedFailure: While extractJSON safely slices balanced JSON, it does not validate that the extracted structure satisfies required application properties (types, required fields, non-null values) without depending on external libraries (Zod/AJV).
gaps.supportingEvidence: Phase F json-extractor.mjs requires manual checks after extractJSON() invocation.
gaps.rootCause: Brain lacked a lightweight, zero-dependency schema invariant engine designed specifically for post-LLM extraction validation.
gaps.proposedImprovement: Implement SchemaInvariantValidator: a pure zero-dependency contract checker validating required keys, primitive types ('string', 'number', 'boolean', 'array', 'object'), non-empty string constraints, and array item schemas with structured violation reporting.

gaps.title: Frontend UI Component & Design Tokens Gap
gaps.observedFailure: Zero reusable CSS, React, Vue, or Web Component patterns exist in the 141 synthesized candidate set.
gaps.supportingEvidence: 141 candidates in Phase E.3/E.4 originate predominantly from HuggingFace model weight repositories (Python/C++).
gaps.rootCause: Harvester sources have prioritized HuggingFace model cards over frontend/UI open-source repositories.
gaps.proposedImprovement: Expand Harvester target lists to incorporate established UI component libraries (e.g., shadcn/ui, Radix UI, Tailwind CSS).

gaps.title: Full-Stack Server Middleware & API Route Contracts Gap
gaps.observedFailure: Brain lacks standardized HTTP route handlers, request validation middleware, and rate-limiting contracts.
gaps.supportingEvidence: Zero full-stack Express/Fastify/Next.js API route templates in 05_KNOWLEDGE.
gaps.rootCause: Current engineering patterns focus on isolated algorithms rather than full-stack service lifecycles.
gaps.proposedImprovement: Harvest and crystallize high-throughput HTTP gateway middleware patterns from top Node/Go servers.
